enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes again. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash: showering, brushing teeth, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making toast, and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on stove. Turn on stove. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Butter toast. Pour boiling water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash dishes. Wipe table. Turn off stove.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the desk lamp and computer, checking emails, and planning the work-from-home day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit at desk. Plug in desk lamp. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open email client. Check emails. Read emails. Reply to urgent emails. Open calendar. Review schedule. Open word processor. Create document. Type notes. Save document. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer, coordinating community programs and drafting schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check emails. Review tasks. Update task status. Draft schedule. Edit schedule. Make phone call. Discuss program details. Hang up. Enter data in spreadsheet. Save file. Attend virtual meeting. Turn on camera. Greet participants. Take notes. End meeting. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Return to desk.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce. Take out tomatoes. Take out cheese. Take out bread. Place bread on cutting board. Spread mayonnaise. Add lettuce. Add tomato. Add cheese. Close sandwich. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wash plate. Wipe table. Put away ingredients. Close refrigerator.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Lean back. Close eyes. Rest. Open eyes. Look at clock. Stand up. Turn off TV. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer, attending virtual meetings with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check emails. Open video conferencing software. Join meeting. Turn on camera. Greet attendees. Discuss agenda. Share screen. Present slides. Answer questions. Take notes. End meeting. Edit report. Save report. Send email. Go to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Return to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up with the vacuum cleaner and relaxing while watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put away vacuum. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Change channel. Relax.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Simmer. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Wash dishes. Wipe table.

Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn up volume. Turn down volume. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up controller. Turn on TV. Turn on game console. Select game. Start game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Resume game. Play game. Save game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Put down controller. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and scrolling on the phone with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter Bedroom 1. Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like post. Comment on post. Lock phone. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to other side. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to back. Remain still. Turn over. Continue sleeping.
